ideas.pitch: A compliance auditing platform for autonomous AI agents using zero-knowledge proofs to verify agent actions without exposing proprietary company data or operational models.
ideas.title: TrustAudit AI: ZK-Gated Autonomous Agent Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the CIPHER track by directly addressing trust and safety in autonomous AI systems, combining hard cryptography with modern agent frameworks.

ideas.pitch: An offline, jam-resilient threat detection and logging tool deployed on local edge devices that categorizes unauthorized drone telemetry data with deterministic engagement gates.
ideas.title: AegisNode: Edge-Based Counter-UAS Threat Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly channels the hard engineering and defense-tech angle that won the AWS Global Government Hackathon, fitting perfectly into the APEX autonomous intelligence track.

ideas.pitch: An off-grid acoustic monitoring mesh network placed in rural farmlands to track water stress and soil conditions via audio signatures, syncing data via walkie-talkie relays.
ideas.title: AgriMesh: Offline LoRa Acoustic Sensor Mesh for Drought Resilience
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs an unusual physical/hardware angle combined with national impact, mirroring the winning approach of ICHack's hardware winner.

ideas.pitch: An AML-inspired graph intelligence and risk detection platform that analyzes state welfare distribution datasets to uncover, explain, and mitigate systemic allocation biases.
ideas.title: FairRoute: Graph-Intelligence Bias Detector for Public Schemes
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced graph analytics and bias mitigation into a tangible tool for national transformation, directly appealing to PRAGATI judges.

ideas.pitch: A defense-in-depth security proxy and tool-calling wrapper that intercepts and sanitizes malicious prompts before they reach backend enterprise autonomous agents.
ideas.title: SecureGuard: Multi-Layer Prompt Injection Shield for Enterprise LLMs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses intensely on cybersecurity and digital trust infrastructure, aligning cleanly with the CIPHER track criteria using proven defense-in-depth patterns.
